— Concept Pitch — 01
tarte × Jellycat
Type — Brand Collaboration Pitch
Inspiration — Maracuja Juicy Lip
Fig. 01 — product render, gift box, and plush concept
A collaboration concept pairing tarte's playful maximalism with Jellycat's whimsical, tactile world: a limited-edition Maracuja Juicy Lip packaged with a Jellycat bunny charm, alongside a plush concept that turns the product itself into a collectible character.
— Concept Pitch — 02
tarte × Mimi's Froyo
Type — Local Activation Pitch
Location — New York, NY
Fig. 02 — in-hand shots and product flatlay from the concept activation
A local NYC pop-up activation concept pairing product sampling with a playful, sweet in-person moment: a co-branded froyo topping bar at Mimi's, with tarte products styled alongside the cup for a natural, shareable content moment.
— Concept Pitch — 03
Trip to Bodrum
Type — Brand Trip Concept
Location — Bodrum, Turkey
Fig. 03 — branded deck chairs, poolside styling
Fig. 04 — branded beach ring, shoreline lifestyle shot
A brand trip / wellness retreat concept set on the Turkish coast, built around slow mornings and golden hour content, with tarte branding woven into the setting itself.
— Concept Pitch — 04
Fall Miscellaneous
Type — Lifestyle Content Concept
Season — Fall
Fig. 05 — product integration at a froyo counter
Fig. 06 — iced coffee counter styling

A grab-bag of smaller fall lifestyle placements: tucking the Maracuja line into everyday morning moments, cafe counters, and cozy flatlays, rather than one single big concept.
